process_area.title: Property Joint-Ventures, LGU Zoning Compliance & Site Development Governance

value_stream.name: Landbanking, Site Acquisition & Agrarian/LGU Zoning Conversion Operations

fields.Owner: VP Store Operations / Director, Facilities & Real Estate
fields.Participants: Landowner, Legal (VS-100), Finance (VS-17.4), BuildRight Property Management, Inc.
fields.Trigger: Strategic target site owned by prominent local family refusing outright sale but open to JV development

workflows.name: Joint-Venture (JV) Landowner Development Agreement Negotiation & Structuring

Controls: - CTL-766 (ensure controlled execution — Property Joint-Ventures, LGU Zoning Compliance & Site Development Governance (PA-178.3).)
- CTL-766: JV agreements reviewed by External Counsel, approved by Board of Directors (VS-36); corporate bank accounts mapped.
Cross-references: - links to VS-100 (legal), VS-17.4 (FP&A), VS-72 (shared services), VS-40 (capex), VS-36 (governance)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Landowner default / Title liens**: Landowner encumbers land after JV execution; mitigated by annotating JV agreement on land title TCT.
System Touchpoints: - Legal contract database (VS-100), intercompany ledger (VS-72), ERP asset capitalization (VS-40).

steps.a: VP Store Operations / Director, Facilities & Real Estate
steps.activity: Conduct commercial modeling: analyze land appraisal value vs. BuildRight's store-construction Capex.
steps.r: VP Store Operations / Director, Facilities & Real Estate

steps.a: VP Store Operations / Director, Facilities & Real Estate
steps.activity: Structure JV terms: land contribution as landowner equity; cash contribution and store building as BuildRight equity; negotiate lease rentals, revenue sharing, or store-in-store concession rights.
steps.r: VP Store Operations / Director, Facilities & Real Estate

steps.a: VP Store Operations / Director, Facilities & Real Estate
steps.activity: Draft JV Development Agreement defining governance, board seats, profit distribution, and exit strategies.
steps.r: VP Store Operations / Director, Facilities & Real Estate

steps.a: VP Store Operations / Director, Facilities & Real Estate
steps.activity: Incorporate a site-specific joint venture entity or register JV agreement under `BuildRight Property Management, Inc.`
steps.r: VP Store Operations / Director, Facilities & Real Estate

fields.Participants: BuildRight Property Management Inc., BuildRight Depot Inc., Finance (VS-17.4), Legal (VS-100)
fields.Trigger: New site acquired or leased in landowner JV under BuildRight Property Management, Inc.

workflows.name: BuildRight Property Management intercompany Lease Structuring & Transfer Pricing

Automation Opportunity: - ERP automated intercompany invoice generation and PFRS 16 lease schedule calculation.
Controls: - CTL-766 (ensure controlled execution — Property Joint-Ventures, LGU Zoning Compliance & Site Development Governance (PA-178.3).)
- CTL-766: Lease approved by both entity controllers; transfer pricing documentation updated annually.
Cross-references: - links to VS-148 (lease accounting), VS-72 (shared services), VS-17.4 (FP&A), VS-79 (tax), VS-100 (legal)
Pain Points / Risks: - **BIR Transfer Pricing adjustments**: Non-arm's length rental pricing causing tax penalties; mitigated by formal transfer pricing study and appraisal matching.
System Touchpoints: - ERP Lease management engine (VS-148), intercompany settlement portal (VS-72), Tax ledger (VS-79).
Time Estimate: - ~4–8 hours of BuildRight effort; 5–10 working days elapsed incl. external tax/TP review

steps.a: Tax Manager / Corporate Controller
steps.activity: Conduct local market rental appraisal to determine arm's-length rental rates for the store site.
steps.r: Tax Manager / Corporate Controller

steps.a: Tax Manager / Corporate Controller
steps.activity: Draft intercompany lease agreement between `BuildRight Property Management, Inc.` (lessor) and `BuildRight Depot, Inc.` (lessee).
steps.r: Tax Manager / Corporate Controller

steps.a: Tax Manager / Corporate Controller
steps.activity: Submit lease structure to transfer pricing specialists to verify compliance with BIR Transfer Pricing guidelines and PFRS 16 lease accounting parameters (VS-148).
steps.r: Tax Manager / Corporate Controller

steps.a: Tax Manager / Corporate Controller
steps.activity: Execute lease agreement and configure intercompany billing schedules in ERP.
steps.r: Tax Manager / Corporate Controller

fields.Owner: Regulatory Compliance Officer / Land Liaison Officer
fields.Participants: LGU Zoning Administrator, Local Zoning Board of Appeals (LZBA)
fields.Trigger: Locational clearance review indicating site zoning is borderline or conflicts with new CLUP maps

workflows.name: LGU Comprehensive Land Use Plan (CLUP) Conformity & Zoning Variance Application

Controls: - CTL-766 (ensure controlled execution — Property Joint-Ventures, LGU Zoning Compliance & Site Development Governance (PA-178.3).)
- CTL-766: LZBA Board Resolution certified and filed with LGU City Engineer; signed copy attached to building permit application.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Locational clearance denial**: Store building permit blocked; mitigated by proactive LZBA presentation and local community support letters.
System Touchpoints: - LGU zoning map database, Legal case system (VS-100).

steps.a: Regulatory Compliance Officer / Land Liaison Officer
steps.activity: File formal Application for Zoning Variance / Exception with the LGU Zoning Administrator.
steps.r: Regulatory Compliance Officer / Land Liaison Officer

steps.a: Regulatory Compliance Officer / Land Liaison Officer
steps.activity: Provide variance justification: job creation (~29 employees per store directly, plus construction labor), local business growth, and tax contributions.
steps.r: Regulatory Compliance Officer / Land Liaison Officer

steps.a: Regulatory Compliance Officer / Land Liaison Officer
steps.activity: Present case before the Local Zoning Board of Appeals; address environmental, traffic, and noise concerns.
steps.r: Regulatory Compliance Officer / Land Liaison Officer

steps.a: Regulatory Compliance Officer / Land Liaison Officer
steps.activity: Secure LZBA Board Resolution granting the zoning variance or exception clearance.
steps.r: Regulatory Compliance Officer / Land Liaison Officer

fields.Participants: Barangay Chairman, Adjacent landowners, City Engineer, Legal (VS-100)
fields.Trigger: Zoning ordinance/variance approved; site access requires traversing private plots or LGU easements

workflows.name: Barangay Clearance, Road Right-of-Way (RROW) & Easement Agreement Negotiation

Controls: - CTL-766 (ensure controlled execution — Property Joint-Ventures, LGU Zoning Compliance & Site Development Governance (PA-178.3).)
- CTL-766: Notarized RROW agreements checked by Legal; Barangay Clearance secured before mobilization.
Cross-references: - links to VS-88 (document control), VS-100 (legal), VS-76 (LGU compliance)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Access blockade**: Adjacent owner blocks utility/road access during construction; mitigated by early notarized RROW agreements annotated on titles.
System Touchpoints: - Barangay clearance logs, Legal contract repository (VS-88).

steps.a: VP Legal & Compliance
steps.activity: Apply for Barangay Clearance for the construction project at the local Barangay Hall.
steps.r: Land Liaison Officer / CSR Manager

steps.a: VP Legal & Compliance
steps.activity: Negotiate Road Right-of-Way (RROW) and easement agreements with adjacent private landowners (multi-party negotiation over weeks) to secure highway and utility connectivity.
steps.r: Land Liaison Officer / CSR Manager

steps.a: VP Legal & Compliance
steps.activity: Draft easement agreements specifying compensation, restoration terms, and structural rules.
steps.r: Land Liaison Officer / CSR Manager

steps.a: VP Legal & Compliance
steps.activity: Notarize and annotate RROW/easement agreements on adjacent property titles at the Registry of Deeds to guarantee permanent access (2–4 weeks elapsed incl. RoD queue).
steps.r: Land Liaison Officer / CSR Manager

fields.Trigger: Barangay clearance and zoning reclassification/variance secured

workflows.name: LGU Locational Clearance & Zoning Permit Application

Controls: - CTL-766 (ensure controlled execution — Property Joint-Ventures, LGU Zoning Compliance & Site Development Governance (PA-178.3).)
- CTL-766: Locational Clearance Certificate secured and verified against local building setback plans.
Cross-references: - links to VS-88 (document control), VS-76 (LGU compliance)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Zoning permit delay**: Missing papers causing LGU backlog; mitigated by complete technical folder preparation and checklist audit.
System Touchpoints: - LGU zoning system, Document control vault (VS-88).

steps.a: Regulatory Compliance Officer

steps.a: Regulatory Compliance Officer

steps.r: Regulatory Compliance Officer

workflows.name: Groundbreaking Site Mobilization & Fencing Permit Management

Controls: - CTL-766 (ensure controlled execution — Property Joint-Ventures, LGU Zoning Compliance & Site Development Governance (PA-178.3).)
- CTL-766: OBO Fencing Permit displayed at site entrance; safety hazard signages posted.
Cross-references: - links to VS-24 (HSE), VS-98 (contingent workforce), VS-112 (PMO)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Boundary encroachment during fencing**: Fencing built on adjacent land causing disputes; mitigated by Geodetic Engineer layout verification.
System Touchpoints: - LGU OBO database, ERP project tracking (VS-112), Security scheduling (VS-98).
Time Estimate: - ~4–8 hours of BuildRight effort; 5–10 working days elapsed incl. external tax/TP review

steps.a: Director of Construction PMO / Site Engineer

steps.r: Director of Construction PMO / Site Engineer

steps.r: Director of Construction PMO / Site Engineer

steps.activity: Set up temporary site office, security guard post (VS-98), and construction worker facilities.
steps.r: Director of Construction PMO / Site Engineer

steps.a: Director of Construction PMO / Site Engineer
steps.activity: Conduct pre-groundbreaking safety briefing (VS-24) and secure OBO fencing permit approval.
steps.r: Director of Construction PMO / Site Engineer

workflows.name: Site Development Capex Budgeting & Milestone Release

Automation Opportunity: - ERP milestone-based automatic payment trigger upon milestone status approval.
Controls: - CTL-766 (ensure controlled execution — Property Joint-Ventures, LGU Zoning Compliance & Site Development Governance (PA-178.3).)
- CTL-766: Payments match project budget; three-way match on land services invoices; CFO approval on land cash outputs.
Cross-references: - links to VS-40 (capex), VS-18 (treasury), VS-15 (P2P), VS-112 (PMO)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Budget overruns**: Land conversion delays or penalty payments blowing the land budget; mitigated by contingency allocations and monthly Capex reviews.
System Touchpoints: - ERP Capex module (VS-40), Treasury cash management (VS-18), AP workflow (VS-15).

steps.a: CFO

steps.r: Treasury / Project Accountant

workflows.name: Site Handover to Construction Project PMO

Automation Opportunity: - Digital site folder migration in document management system.
Controls: - CTL-766 (ensure controlled execution — Property Joint-Ventures, LGU Zoning Compliance & Site Development Governance (PA-178.3).)
- CTL-766: Handover Protocol signed by Real Estate Director and Construction PMO Director; documented in project file.
Cross-references: - links to VS-112 (PMO), VS-20 (construction), VS-35 (fixed assets), VS-88 (document control)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Missing documents delay construction**: Building permit blocked due to incomplete title/clearance files; mitigated by strict handover checklist verification.
System Touchpoints: - Project management portal (VS-112), Asset master system (VS-35), Document library (VS-88).

steps.a: Director, Facilities & Real Estate & Land Acquisition

steps.r: Director, Facilities & Real Estate & Land Acquisition

steps.r: Director, Facilities & Real Estate & Land Acquisition

steps.a: Director, Facilities & Real Estate & Land Acquisition
steps.activity: Sign off on formal Site Handover Protocol, transferring site responsibility and security to the Construction PMO.
steps.r: Director, Facilities & Real Estate & Land Acquisition
